procedural_matters: GER 223725 was represented by Levian Buescher.
Maximillien Walkenbach (coach of GER 223725) attended the hearing as a party.
Hearing No. 1 was heard together with hearing No. 5 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
facts: The wind was 15 kts with choppy water at the start of race 1 for the ILCA 6 men.
3:20 before the start, GER 223725 handed his jacket to his coach 30 metres to leeward of the starting line.
The start was clear, and GER 223725 started and finished the race.
conclusions: By handinghis jacket to his coach, GER 223725 received outside help, and broke RRS 41 while racing.
Maximillien Walkenbach was less than 50 metres to leeward of the starting line, therefore he broke ESTR 5.1.2.
decision: For each race held on 09/06/2025, Maximillien Walkenbach shall anchor his support person vessel 70 metres below the starting line from the time the orange flag is displayed until all starts of that race are completed.
